name: Oslo Hackney
summary: A late-opening bar, gig room and club spread over two floors of Hackney Central's former station building, a 140-year-old structure, open since 2014. Gigs happen in the upstairs room, while the ground-floor bar has DJs late into the night, plus pizza and cocktails.

music.notes: Live shows upstairs from artists across a wide range of genres, with DJs in the ground-floor bar until late.

crowd: Time Out describes the crowd as lively and mixed.

evidence.quote: Oslo Hackney is a double-decker late-night bar, gig venue and club that opened inside a 140-year-old former Hackney Central station in 2014.

Downstairs, the bar has DJs until late – along with plenty of Italian-American-style Cowboys Pizza pies and 2-4-£14 cocktails served up daily – while upstairs, there’s a gig club venue with an impressive capacity of up to 375.
Hosting an array of musical artists and genres, Oslo caters to an energetic, mixed crowd.
Capacity 370 Address 1a Amhurst Road, Hackney, London, E8 1LL
